description: Java class HonoReceiver for connecting to AMQP network, receiving messages, and collecting statistics for JMeter testing.

classes.name: HonoReceiver
classes.description: A receiver class that connects to AMQP network, receives messages, and tracks statistics for JMeter.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the receiver by establishing connection and creating a consumer.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to the Hono AMQP network.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Creates a telemetry or event consumer based on endpoint.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Collects and resets statistics for a test sample.

methods.name: messageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, updates counters, and calculates delivery times.

methods.name: setSampleStartIfNotSetYet
methods.description: Sets the start timestamp for sampling if not already set.

methods.name: getSenderTime
methods.description: Extracts sender time from message payload or properties.

methods.name: getSenderTimeFromJsonPayload
methods.description: Parses JSON payload to get sender time.

methods.name: getSenderTimeFromMessageProperties
methods.description: Retrieves sender time from message application properties.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the connection to the AMQP network.
